# Painting Anyone on the station can paint. Grab a canvas and something to paint with, and make some art for the halls.
## Supplies
Canvases come in three sizes: square, landscape and small. Craft them from a wood plank and some cloth, or order the art supplies crate from cargo. An easel, built from 4 wood planks, holds a canvas so you can paint it standing up.
## Painting tools
You can paint using crayons in their own colour, or print an empty paint can at an autolathe and fill it with any liquid.
The artist's palette mixes any colour, has the biggest brushes, and is the only tool that can erase. You can only get one from cargo.
## The painting window Use a painting tool on a canvas, or on an easel holding one, to open the window. To look at a canvas without painting, use it in your hand or activate it on the floor.
Pick a tool from the top row of the left panel: brush, eraser, line, rectangle, ellipse or colour picker. The colour picker copies a colour off the canvas, but can ONLY be used with the palette or rainbow crayon. Once again, only the palette can erase.
Below the tools are four brush styles (round, square, spray and calligraphy) and a size slider. How big you can go depends on what you're holding. Crayons are limited to 3 pixels, paint cans 6 and the palette 12.
Ctrl+Z or the undo button takes back your own recent drawing. ## Finishing and framing
When you're done, give your painting a title and press [bold]Finish and sign[/bold]. A signed painting CAN NOT be changed, so make sure you're finished.
Use a frame on a signed painting to frame it. Frames can be crafted from wood, steel, bones, brass, silver, gold or diamond. The clown and the mime each get a unique frame in their lockers, only one of them exists at a time so use them for something special!
## Copies
A photocopier copies a painting onto a blank canvas of the same size. Put a finished and blank canvas in and activate it.
To build one, print a photocopier machine board at a circuit imprinter.
